tasks.label: checkforsettings
tasks.detail: Check that settings.json has been created

tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: Build frontend, musl backend and plugin ZIP

tasks.label: buildall
tasks.detail: Install dependencies and build the plugin ZIP

tasks.label: chmodfolders
tasks.detail: Let deck write the plugins folder (sudo asks for the password in the terminal)

tasks.label: deploy
tasks.command: rm -rf out/deploy && unzip -q out/decky-storage-cleaner-rust.zip -d out/deploy && rsync -azp --delete --chmod=D0755,F0755 --rsh='ssh -p ${config:deckport} ${config:deckkey}' out/deploy/decky-storage-cleaner-rust/ deck@${config:deckip}:${config:deckdir}/homebrew/plugins/decky-storage-cleaner-rust

tasks.label: restartloader
tasks.detail: Restart Decky Loader so it loads the new build (the Rust fork runs as a user service)
tasks.command: ssh -t deck@${config:deckip} -p ${config:deckport} ${config:deckkey} 'systemctl --user restart plugin_loader 2>/dev/null || sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader'
